We're staying. The people who live here need our protection.|Drash, to Boba Fett|}} '''Drash''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] leader of a [[Mods|street gang]] within the [[Worker's District]] of the [[city]] [[Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine]]. She and her gang joined the [[Fett gotra]] and took part in the [[Battle of Mos Espa]] which saw the [[Pyke Syndicate]] driven off Tatooine. ==Biography== ===Early life=== Drash grew up in a neighborhood of [[Mos Espa]] a "[[Womp rat|womp]] hop" away from an alley where she would later clash with [[Pyke Syndicate]] forces. At some point she joined and the [[Mods]] street gang, serving as their leader.>''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ===Working for Boba Fett=== {{Quote|You live in the Worker's District. You all should be working.''"
"''There is no work, Mighty Daimyo. Look around you.''"
"''Then you will work for me. You got guts, I'll give you that. You better fight as good as you talk dank.|Boba Fett and Drash|}} [[File:BobaHiresMods-BoBFCh3.png|thumb|left|300px|Fett hired the Mods to work for him, and settled their debt with the water monger.]] After the street gang's thefts were reported to the new [[Daimyo]], [[Boba Fett]], by the [[Water monger|water-monger]] [[Lortha Peel]], Fett confronted the criminals. Drash informed him that the gang was stealing because there was no work for them to earn money from, and Fett subsequently recruited them to work for him. The street gang later assisted Fett in fending off the [[Wookiee]] [[gladiator]] [[Krrsantan]], who was sent to [[Assassination attempt on Boba Fett|kill]] him by the [[Hutt]]s known as [[the Twins]], and later [[Chase through Mos Espa|pursued]] the [[Mok Shaiz's majordomo|majordomo]] of [[Mayor of Mos Espa|Mayor]] [[Mok Shaiz]] in a chase through the streets of Mos Espa. Drash was present for a meeting about the rising threat of the Pyke Syndicate as the crime syndicate gathered troops in Mos Espa. [[Fennec Shand]] summarized the Pyke's culmination of forces and mentioned [[Mok Shaiz]] fleeing off world as a sign war was about to break out.{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}} During an ambush in the [[Worker's District]] of Mos Espa, Drash, and other Mods, were rescued by Shand. She was the only one to say "thank you," a gesture that impressed Shand. She fought alongside the [[Freetown garrison]] against the [[Pyke Syndicate|Pyke's]] [[Scorpenek annihilator droid|Scorpenek droid]]s during the [[Battle of Mos Espa]]. She temporarily traded her blaster pistol for [[Taanti]]'s [[Cycler rifle]] before taking to the rooftops to snipe [[Pyke]]s, alongside [[Jo]]. ==Personality and traits== [[File:Drash-TBoBFHV.png|thumb|right|200px|Drash was a confident woman with a cybernetic arm.]] {{Quote|Hey. Thank you.''"
"''Manners. I like it.|Drash and Shand, afer the latter rescued the Mods|}} Drash had pale skin, [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]]. Her body modifications appeared to be limited to a cybernetic replacement of her left arm. It had a distinctive red color that matched other pieces of her attire. ==Equipment== Drash carried a retractile [[vibro-stiletto]] and [[hold-out blaster]] pistol. She once exchanged the pistol for a [[Cycler rifle]] during the Battle of Mos Espa. She rode a blue speeder bike with two sets of shiny mirrors flaring from the sides. ==Behind the scenes== Drash was introduced in "[[Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa]]," the third episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[January 12]], [[2022]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}} She was portrayed by [[Sophie Thatcher]], with [[Callie Croughwell]] and [[Crystal Hooks]] acting as stunt doubles. Though not named in the episode, Drash was identified in the stunt performers' credits.
